sentences.text:
The prayers in this Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India are as follows:-
"a) Direct the 2nd respondent to submit before this Hon'ble court a full report regarding the materials collected by him till date after the registration of Exhibit P1.
b) Direct the 2nd respondent to report this Hon'ble court the time required for completing his investigation.

c) Direct the 3rd respondent to supervise the investigation conducted by R2.
d) Grant such other relief as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper"
2.

The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the Punaloor Police registered Crime No.936 of 2025 alleging offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 471 and 34 of IPC against three persons, based on the complaint lodged by the petitioner.
The learned Public Prosecutor further submitted that the petitioner is not co-operating with 2026:KER:19961 W.P.(Crl)No.1630 of 2025 4 the investigation in the matter.
